Question B-002-009-006.

Why the correct answer is right: If the short-path direction does not work, trying the antenna 180 degrees away tests the long-path direction.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Point your antenna 90 degrees west of the current bearing": Ninety degrees west is a side direction, not the reciprocal path.
- sourceIndex 2: "Point your antenna 90 degrees east of the current bearing": Ninety degrees east is also perpendicular rather than opposite.
- sourceIndex 3: "Point your antenna further south": “Further south” is vague and may not match the required reciprocal bearing.
